old_problem: Items labels the case Chassis, but the explicit URI is `/Systems/system`, a ComputerSystem member; Criteria ends with stray `sm`. Prior review asked the owner to choose ComputerSystem versus linked Chassis. DMTF resource semantics and the preceding collection row make the member identity technically determinable; DeepSeek's IPMI command remains inapplicable.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. DMTF defines `/redfish/v1/Systems/{ComputerSystemId}` as ComputerSystem; this row follows the row-1960 Systems collection and therefore validates its discovered member. The Items label and `sm` typo remain traceable but cannot convert the resource to Chassis. Any linked `/Chassis/{id}` is recorded for identity correlation only and needs separate coverage. Secure discovery/schema/value validation replaces hardcoded `system`, unsafe curl and IPMI. Exact expected fields are Project Configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1961, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, preceding collection row and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1962 / Wistron-BMC-00998-V002 / 131a88133bbc70fd.
DMTF DSP0268 defines ComputerSystem members under `/redfish/v1/Systems/{ComputerSystemId}`; resource identity comes from discovered `@odata.id`/`@odata.type`, not the testcase label.
Hardcoded member ID `system` is replaced by following the Systems collection's member link; linked Chassis is captured but cannot be called the same resource.
The trailing `sm` has no defined semantic value and is retained as a typographical defect; the intact criterion is readable, correct, error-free ComputerSystem data.
IPMI chassis status cannot prove Redfish URI, resource type, schema or payload values; URL credentials and TLS bypass are prohibited.
No Redfish, curl, IPMI, authentication, session, network, BMC or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Discovered Redfish ComputerSystem member schema, identity, links and value validation
test_case.purpose: Discover and validate the exact ComputerSystem member from the approved Systems collection over trusted authenticated Redfish, including schema, system identity/state and Chassis link correlation, while keeping actual Chassis-resource coverage distinct.
required_package: Exact BMC/firmware/Redfish service identity, Systems collection/member oracle and matching ComputerSystem/OEM schema profile
Versioned required ComputerSystem identity, PowerState, Status, BIOS/model/serial and link/value matrix for the platform
Certificate-validating Redfish client, structured JSON/OData validator, protected read-only secret/session and bounded timeouts
Evidence redaction/hash policy and approved management account scope
Explicit source-defect record for Items `Chassis` and trailing `sm`, plus separate actual Chassis coverage ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; discover the service root and approved Systems collection, select the expected unique member URI instead of assuming `/system`, then GET it with verified TLS and protected secrets. Preserve redacted status/headers and full JSON hash; require ComputerSystem `@odata.type`/schema, expected identity/state/links and field values, and verify linked Chassis URI only as a relation. Do not validate that linked Chassis payload as this row, use URL credentials/`-k`, substitute IPMI, issue writes or retry insecurely.
test_case.expected_result: The discovered expected member returns 2xx valid JSON with matching ComputerSystem resource identity/schema, exact approved system identity/state/required fields and valid expected links; linked Chassis identity is consistent but remains separate coverage. No payload/error/secret issue occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires trusted target/TLS/authentication, discovered correct member, ComputerSystem resource/schema validation and every required semantic value/link. FAIL on wrong member/resource type, auth/TLS/HTTP/JSON/schema/value/link error or leakage. NOT READY covers absent member/value/schema/trust/credential oracle. IPMI output, a guessed `/system`, linked Chassis data or HTTP 200 alone cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Only bounded GET; prohibit actions and POST/PATCH/DELETE.
Use verified TLS and protected secrets; no URL/CLI password or `-k`.
Discover member identity; stop on unexpected count/member/redirect/resource type or leakage.
Keep actual Chassis validation separate, preserve logs and close/revoke sessions without insecure retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and source-defect disposition, BMC/firmware/Redfish/schema/client/TLS/account identities
Systems collection member discovery and selected exact `@odata.id`
Redacted member status/payload hash, ComputerSystem OData/schema and required field/value comparison
Linked Chassis URI correlation labeled non-coverage and trailing-sm audit
test_case.recovery: On TLS, authentication, member, schema, payload or evidence failure, stop and close/revoke the session; rotate any exposed secret and preserve redacted audit data. Do not fall back to `-k`, hardcoded `/system`, IPMI or write methods; use the approved BMC support path.
